attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Grinning Jack's Men are reportedly making moves near the outer rim.","severity":"major","reason":"No such event in the briefing; the pirates are only listed with a settlement count."},{"span":"Archery remains a point of contention, as expected.","severity":"minor","reason":"Asserts the old archery argument is still ongoing; the briefing gives no update."},{"span":"They seem interested in someone who is likely trouble.","severity":"minor","reason":"Characterises Leopold as trouble without support, only lightly hedged."}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"With only one new item, the writer padded the bulletin with an invented pirate story and recycled the old spring games as a current development, which the instructions forbid.
